title: Candidate, hypothesis, and role mechanisms
description: Artifact contracts and complete port typings for the 22 mechanisms in Section 4 of the v4 mechanism census.

artifactTypes.label: Native color histogram with role evidence
artifactTypes.description: Stable native-image color bins carrying population, field, salience, chroma, and typography evidence.
sourceNotes: Section 4 uses the native histogram both as the role-aware shortlist source and as the supplementation source.
provenanceNotes: Bins remain tied to native observations; weighted centers are not publishable source colors.

artifactTypes.label: Role-aware exact-color shortlist candidate
artifactTypes.description: One shortlisted color with cluster and evidence provenance and an exact observed source representative.
sourceNotes: The historical shortlist is about 12 records but may contain only one record for a uniform source.
provenanceNotes: Candidacy does not grant role reachability, role assignment, or final selection.

artifactTypes.label: Reviewed hue-family supplementation configuration
artifactTypes.description: The bounded reviewed fixed-family, support, chroma, salience, connectivity, absence, and two-supplement policy.
sourceNotes: Support is scientific only in the bounded reviewed configuration cited by candidate.hue-family-supplement.
provenanceNotes: This configuration is authority for the bounded diagnostic behavior, not for a role or treatment selection.

artifactTypes.label: Exact-source hue-family supplement
artifactTypes.description: One exact observed source color from a supported chromatic family absent from the canonical shortlist.
sourceNotes: A run emits zero, one, or two supplements; the output is not an augmented shortlist.
provenanceNotes: Supplement availability grants neither role authorization nor final selection.

artifactTypes.label: Hue-family supplement availability diagnostics
artifactTypes.description: Per-family availability, rejection, support, and perceptual-absence observations for supplementation.
sourceNotes: Availability remained distinct from downstream role and complete-treatment utility.
provenanceNotes: Diagnostics retain the reviewed configuration identity and do not become cold-inference review inputs.

artifactTypes.label: Source-connected color-family evidence
artifactTypes.description: One color family with prototype, exact representatives, components, population, chroma, salience, connectivity, field ownership, and polarity observations where measured.
sourceNotes: Section 4 consumes family evidence without treating a family as an elected UI role.
provenanceNotes: Every exact representative retains its source witness; synthesized representatives are identified separately.

artifactTypes.label: Occupied field endpoint band
artifactTypes.description: One low or high occupied local band with its pixels, support distribution, spread, geometry, and fit lineage.
sourceNotes: Endpoint-band evidence is local to an accepted fit and is not interchangeable with a global family.
provenanceNotes: Band identity and low/high orientation remain attached to all derived representatives.

artifactTypes.label: Family representative alternative
artifactTypes.description: One dense-exact, nearest-prototype, band-local endpoint, or historical density-synthesized family representative with support and tie provenance.
sourceNotes: The finite alternatives expose support and fidelity tradeoffs rather than declaring one universal representative.
provenanceNotes: Exact witnesses are required where applicable; density-synthesized values remain marked as non-ordinary publication.

artifactTypes.label: Family component and observation evidence
artifactTypes.description: Source-connected components and observations carrying support geometry, repetition, text, mark, contrast, and field measurements.
sourceNotes: Component observations support field, typography, accent, and identity hypotheses without semantic authority by themselves.
provenanceNotes: Region and family identifiers preserve native-image lineage.

artifactTypes.label: Field-domain evidence
artifactTypes.description: One supported spatial domain proposed for a field, including ownership, population, border, corner, and geometry evidence.

notes: Only the accepted discriminator is inspected where downstream historical routes require an accepted field domain.
This declaration exposes one source-backed state path and is not a complete field-domain JSON schema.

sourceNotes: A field domain is evidence for a hypothesis and not proof of one physical surface.
provenanceNotes: Domain identifiers remain stable through fits, transitions, and endpoint refinements.

artifactTypes.label: P5 robust field model and residual aggregate
artifactTypes.description: The complete P5 fit aggregate containing fitted flat, block, linear, or radial model records, paired residual and inlier-weight fields, absolute explained fractions, alternatives, abstention, and recursion state.
sourceNotes: Aggregates exactly the P5 robust model, residual, inlier-weight, explained-fraction, abstention, and recursion outputs without asserting historical v2-3 GradientFitDiagnostic semantics.
provenanceNotes: Retains every model-to-residual pairing, selected sample lattice, scores, explained fractions, abstention reason, recursion, source identity, and resource observations.

artifactTypes.label: Accepted historical GradientFitDiagnostic
artifactTypes.description: One accepted v2-3 gradient fit diagnostic carrying source field domain, direction and topology, spatial parameter positions, occupied endpoint bands, progression and residual evidence, and exact-source support needed by endpoint and midpoint routes.
sourceNotes: Historical band-local endpoint and spatial-midpoint routes consume an accepted GradientFitDiagnostic; no separate census mechanism produces that accepted diagnostic contract.
provenanceNotes: This accepted historical diagnostic is not interchangeable with a P5 robust model/residual aggregate and remains an explicit internal handoff gap.

artifactTypes.label: Native-seed field hypothesis
artifactTypes.description: A flat, separate-field, or gradient field hypothesis produced by the native seed path with endpoint, geometry, fidelity, support, and rejection provenance.
sourceNotes: The ontology retains competing hypotheses rather than inferring a gradient from two colors.
provenanceNotes: The source type is exactly native-seed and is never erased by later union or treatment deduplication.

artifactTypes.label: Native family-component graph
artifactTypes.description: Native family components, adjacency, edge steps, and supported spatial domains used to inspect continuous field transitions.
sourceNotes: Graph connectivity is evidence and does not assert one semantic surface.
provenanceNotes: Nodes and edges retain family, region, and native support identifiers.

artifactTypes.label: Declared native transition-path configuration
artifactTypes.description: Endpoint, bridge, directness, continuity, branching, domain-support, ordering, and maximum-16-stage policy for transition discovery.
sourceNotes: Runtime permission is limited to a declared configuration because many constants gate paths.
provenanceNotes: Configuration identity must accompany traces and hypotheses.

artifactTypes.label: Native-transition field hypothesis
artifactTypes.description: One eligible continuous-field hypothesis derived from an ordered native component path of at most 16 exact-color stages.
sourceNotes: Zero or more hypotheses may be emitted; a connected path may still join distinct semantic areas.
provenanceNotes: The source type is exactly native-field-transition and endpoint and stage identities remain attached.

artifactTypes.label: Ordered native field-transition path evidence
artifactTypes.description: One exact-source native field-transition path record with its complete untrimmed ordered stages, including rejected no-path records with zero stages and rejected over-limit records with more than sixteen stages, exact stage colors and witnesses, endpoint identities and order, topology and domain, progression and support, accepted intermediate support, legacy and current eligibility, an associated field hypothesis or null, and complete rejection reasons.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md:731-746 defines zero or more ordered native transition traces and hypotheses with exact stage colors, endpoint identities, eligibility, and rejection reasons; field-transition.ts:756-784 rejects paths over the configured 16-stage acceptance cap, while :992-1078 publishes every record with its untrimmed stages for direct consumption by gradient-support.ts:197-233.
provenanceNotes: Every stage retains family and region IDs, spatial and color positions, population, exact RGB/OKLab/hex color, native pixel index, and coordinates; zero-stage and over-limit rejected records, endpoint identities, eligibility flags, nullable hypotheses, and rejection reasons remain present rather than being erased. The 16-stage limit is an acceptance policy recorded through eligibility and rejection state, not a universal artifact-shape bound.

artifactTypes.label: Band-local endpoint field hypothesis
artifactTypes.description: A refined field hypothesis for one accepted fit with exact low/high endpoint representatives, band spread, fit quality, support, and lineage.
sourceNotes: Each accepted fit emits zero or one refinement; local bands can narrow ramps or capture unrelated objects.
provenanceNotes: The source type is exactly band-local-endpoint and remains distinct from seed and transition provenance.

artifactTypes.label: Provenance-preserving field-hypothesis union member
artifactTypes.description: One field hypothesis in the explicit seed, transition, and band-local fan-in, retaining source type and complete lineage.
sourceNotes: Union permits all three producer classes to coexist before complete-treatment deduplication.
provenanceNotes: Equal treatments with distinct evidence retain every descriptor; fan-in does not arbitrate or normalize.

artifactTypes.label: Logical complete-treatment descriptor
artifactTypes.description: One candidate complete-treatment description with field hypothesis, source mode, source type, strata, and source-connected lineage.
sourceNotes: Logical descriptors can describe byte-equivalent treatments through different evidence paths.
provenanceNotes: Descriptor identity includes treatment, field hypothesis, source type, and lineage rather than an ASCII alias.

artifactTypes.label: Canonical candidate treatment with retained descriptors
artifactTypes.description: One candidate per complete treatment key with a stable key, ordered nonduplicate descriptors, and unioned strata.
sourceNotes: Only byte-equivalent complete candidate treatments may share a canonical record.
provenanceNotes: Deduplication retains all consequential evidence and uncertainty and does not make the candidate a final palette.

artifactTypes.label: Ordered identity obligation
artifactTypes.description: One source-connected, materially distinct, non-field-owned family obligation with priority, direction, and evidence provenance.
sourceNotes: The base list has four seats and post-cap major-family and chromatic reservations can increase the output to six.
provenanceNotes: An obligation is a retention hypothesis, not human semantic truth or final role authority.

artifactTypes.label: Stratified materialization capacity policy
artifactTypes.description: A capacity in the inclusive range 1 through 1500 plus field-direction, obligation-role, legal-form, source-stratum, ordering, and tie policies.
sourceNotes: The historical hard maximum is 1500 complete candidate treatments.
provenanceNotes: The cap and strata are consequential policy and must remain visible inputs.

artifactTypes.label: Capacity-materialized candidate treatment
artifactTypes.description: One retained canonical candidate in the ordered capacity-bounded subset with descriptor and stratum-coverage provenance.
sourceNotes: A run retains at least one and at most the configured capacity, never above 1500.
provenanceNotes: Admission under a cap is displacement-sensitive: additions can evict prior candidates without changing their intrinsic evidence.

artifactTypes.label: Endorsed palette review target
artifactTypes.description: A question-scoped reviewer-endorsed complete or partial color sample with warehouse, batch, item, and role-projection custody.
sourceNotes: One or more endorsed samples are effective inputs only to the prohibited development diagnostic.
provenanceNotes: Targets are reviewed records, not natural runtime observations and not universal ground truth.

artifactTypes.label: Reachability matching configuration
artifactTypes.description: Role-blind minimum-cost OKLab matching, epsilon, projection, tie, and aggregation rules for the bounded recall-versus-ranking diagnostic.
sourceNotes: The cited evaluation uses exact permutation matching for four colors and a declared epsilon.
provenanceNotes: Configuration identity is required to interpret reachability and rank values.

artifactTypes.label: Recall-versus-ranking diagnosis
artifactTypes.description: A development-only target diagnosis containing minimum mean OKLab cost, epsilon reachability, best rank, and recall, ranking, or match classification.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Report reviewed-sample reachability without leaking the answer-bearing target into cold inference.
sourceNotes: Role-blind matching measures candidacy versus ranking failure, not seat correctness or product accuracy.
provenanceNotes: Every result remains bound to candidate dump, target record, projection, epsilon, and rank order.

artifactTypes.label: Field-conditional role classifier policy
artifactTypes.description: Foreground, accent, support, ambiguity, polarity, blend, threshold, evidence-banding, and deterministic tie policy.
sourceNotes: Fixed blends and thresholds are pervasive cliffs in the historical classifier.
provenanceNotes: A score margin is not a calibrated probability.

artifactTypes.label: Field-conditioned family role evidence
artifactTypes.description: One family-by-field matrix cell with foreground and accent scores, preference, reason, confidence, coherent support, field ownership, and polarity evidence.
sourceNotes: A complete classifier run emits exactly one record for every family crossed with every field hypothesis.
provenanceNotes: Ambiguous and field-owned states remain explicit; a matrix cell does not elect a role.

artifactTypes.label: Identity-obligation and reservation policy
artifactTypes.description: The four-seat base cap, two-neutral quota, polarity exception and banded reorder, material-distance deduplication, and major and chromatic post-cap reservation policy.
sourceNotes: Both reservations are additive after the base four seats and can yield six obligations.
provenanceNotes: Every quota, exception, deduplication threshold, reservation, ordering band, and tie is causally consequential.

artifactTypes.label: Identity-obligation selection trace
artifactTypes.description: Omitted, field-owned, disconnected, materially duplicate, neutral-quota, polarity-exempt, polarity-reordered, bound-omitted, and major-reserved family traces.
sourceNotes: The historical returned trace includes the major-family reservation but no dedicated chromatic-reservation field.
provenanceNotes: A chromatic reservation is observable in the obligation output even though that omission prevents a symmetric returned trace claim.

artifactTypes.label: Text-like exact-source candidate
artifactTypes.description: One exact-source color nominated by structural text or ink evidence with support, geometry, repetition, and uncertainty.
sourceNotes: Text-like candidates may include decoration, labels, or missed typography and therefore remain hypotheses.
provenanceNotes: Every candidate retains exact source support and structural evidence rather than an OCR truth label.

artifactTypes.label: Foreground polarity observation
artifactTypes.description: A source-supported signed foreground lightness-polarity observation with confidence and family or mark lineage.
sourceNotes: Polarity is evaluated relative to the considered field where required.
provenanceNotes: Unpolarized or weak observations remain represented rather than coerced to a direction.

artifactTypes.label: Candidate-to-field contrast evidence
artifactTypes.description: Signed or absolute contrast measurements for one candidate against a flat field or sampled rendered field.
sourceNotes: Contrast can establish a legibility floor but cannot establish foreground identity.
provenanceNotes: Candidate, field, metric, polarity, sample positions, and minimum location remain attached.

artifactTypes.label: Text-led foreground hypothesis
artifactTypes.description: One foreground hypothesis with elected exact-source candidate or fallback, structural text evidence, polarity, support, contrast, and fallback state.
sourceNotes: The bounded prototype result is not a complete role solution or a final contract palette.
provenanceNotes: Fallback remains explicit so absence or rejection of text evidence is not hidden.

artifactTypes.label: Exact rendered field path
artifactTypes.description: The exact flat or OKLab ramp path, including stops and deterministic dense samples, on which UI content would render.
sourceNotes: Whole-ramp checks include between-stop minima rather than endpoints alone.
provenanceNotes: The path remains tied to its candidate field and render parameters, not to final product selection.

artifactTypes.label: Foreground color candidate
artifactTypes.description: One source-connected candidate color proposed for foreground evaluation without elected-role authority.
sourceNotes: Foreground candidates may be supplied by multiple evidence mechanisms.
provenanceNotes: Candidate identity and exact-source or generated state remain explicit.

artifactTypes.label: Maximin ramp foreground election
artifactTypes.description: Per-candidate minimum absolute raw APCA values plus the argmax candidate, its minimizing ramp position, and deterministic tie record.
sourceNotes: The elected candidate maximizes the legibility floor over the complete rendered path.
provenanceNotes: This output is a bounded floor/election hypothesis, not final foreground identity or a final contract palette.

artifactTypes.label: Accent mark-shape evidence
artifactTypes.description: One family's compactness, repetition, chroma, local contrast, signature observation, coherent support gate, raw score, and exact provenance.
sourceNotes: All five cues and the support gate remain visible; mass alone is not accent evidence.
provenanceNotes: Neutral accents and giant typography remain valid counterexamples to a universal compact-chromatic rule.

artifactTypes.label: Mark support and cue totals
artifactTypes.description: One mark's support mass and unnormalized internal cue totals with region, family, and image-area measurements.
sourceNotes: The denominator distinguishes mark mass from total image area.
provenanceNotes: Original mark mass remains reportable after normalization.

artifactTypes.label: Per-mass mark score and rank
artifactTypes.description: One mark's cue score normalized by mark mass, its deterministic rank, retained original mass, and eligibility state.
sourceNotes: Per-mass normalization prevents small coherent marks from being erased by canvas area.
provenanceNotes: Separate semantic and spatial eligibility is required so tiny noise is not amplified into authority.

artifactTypes.label: Internal complete treatment
artifactTypes.description: A complete internal background, surface, foreground, accent, and field-state treatment with collapse, lineage, legality, and score data. It is not the exact v3 published Palette contract and carries no product authority.
sourceNotes: research/v2-3/src/internal/palette-core.ts:422-442 defines the historical internal CompletePaletteTreatment shape; research/v3/src/contract/types.ts:326-341 defines a distinct published Palette contract.
provenanceNotes: This type intentionally does not identify artifact.product.ui-palette.v3 and must not be treated as published product output.

artifactTypes.label: Foreground-accent swap legality assessment
artifactTypes.description: All pair, stop, contrast, collapse, source, and field legality checks for an unchanged or foreground-accent-swapped candidate treatment.
sourceNotes: Both resulting role pairs and every rendered stop require revalidation.
provenanceNotes: Assessment identifies the treatment, role claims, field, and validation policy.

artifactTypes.label: Text-mark swap candidate result
artifactTypes.description: Exactly the unchanged candidate treatment or one foreground-accent-swapped candidate treatment with repair identity and unchanged color set and field.
sourceNotes: The bounded repair exchanges roles only on decisive text-versus-mark evidence and legal output.
provenanceNotes: This repair result remains a candidate treatment and is not a final contract palette.

artifactTypes.label: Artwork family-relation hypothesis
artifactTypes.description: A hypothesis describing supported sharing and separation relationships among artwork color families without imposing a universal family count.
sourceNotes: Observed covers support incompatible two-family and four-family structures.
provenanceNotes: Relation hypotheses remain artwork-specific and preserve uncertainty.

artifactTypes.label: Treatment-to-artwork family compatibility evidence
artifactTypes.description: Evidence comparing role sharing and separation in one complete candidate treatment with one artwork family-relation hypothesis.
sourceNotes: The output is relational evidence, never a mandatory family count or universal template.
provenanceNotes: Both treatment and artwork relation-hypothesis identifiers remain attached.

artifactTypes.label: Color population and exact mass
artifactTypes.description: Reportable exact-triple population, family population, connected mass, and denominator measurements for one source color.
sourceNotes: Population remains reportable evidence even though no tested threshold established role eligibility.
provenanceNotes: Color witness, source raster, counting rule, and denominator remain explicit.

artifactTypes.label: Population eligibility threshold policy
artifactTypes.description: The historical population or exact-mass floor and comparison rule tested as a role-eligibility gate.
sourceNotes: The threshold gate is scientifically falsified and prohibited for runtime eligibility.
provenanceNotes: Historical threshold identity is retained only to reproduce and diagnose the failed gate.

artifactTypes.label: Historical population eligibility bit
artifactTypes.description: The eligible or ineligible result of applying the tested population floor, retained only as a development diagnostic.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Reproduce the falsified historical gate without allowing it into runtime role eligibility.
sourceNotes: Rare endorsed title, ink, and identity colors falsified this eligibility interpretation.
provenanceNotes: The result remains bound to the exact threshold and population measurement.

artifactTypes.label: Coherent mark group
artifactTypes.description: One spatially coherent candidate mark group with component, geometry, family, and exact-source support.
sourceNotes: Mark groups may represent title text, identity graphics, incidental labels, shadows, or noise.
provenanceNotes: Group membership and source support remain explicit through nomination.

artifactTypes.label: Mark salience and coherence evidence
artifactTypes.description: Salience, spatial coherence, exact-source support, and retained mass diagnostics for one candidate mark group.
sourceNotes: Coherent salience is considered before mass ordering without making rarity an eligibility rule.
provenanceNotes: Mass remains a separate diagnostic and is never discarded by salience normalization.

artifactTypes.label: Salience-led role nomination
artifactTypes.description: One nominated, null, or ambiguous role-candidate state with coherent salience, exact support, semantic limits, and retained mass evidence.
sourceNotes: The mechanism is unbuilt and nomination does not authorize role assignment or selection.
provenanceNotes: Null and ambiguous outcomes remain first-class rather than silently dropping a mark.

artifactTypes.label: Hue-direction support and diversity configuration
artifactTypes.description: Hue bins, chroma weighting, smoothing neighborhood, near-neutral and source-support gates, requested cardinality, PSD kernel, and deterministic greedy tie policy.

notes: Identifies the exact rank-two repository proposal addressed by the conditional bound.
The cited 2D Gram kernel can support at most two selected directions.
These paths expose only the source-stated kernel/rank guard, not the full configuration schema.

sourceNotes: For L_ij = q_i q_j v_i^T v_j with 2D unit hue directions, rank is at most two and requested cardinality must be capped at two or use a valid higher-rank PSD kernel.
provenanceNotes: Kernel identity and rank support are part of the configuration, not an implementation detail.

artifactTypes.label: Smoothed hue-direction support field
artifactTypes.description: A chroma-weighted circular hue support field after declared neighborhood smoothing and source-support gating.
sourceNotes: The proposed source used a 360-bin histogram with a plus-or-minus 15-degree neighborhood.
provenanceNotes: Near-neutral handling, family support, binning, weighting, and smoothing remain attached.

artifactTypes.label: Diverse supported hue direction
artifactTypes.description: One member of a finite source-supported direction set selected under a declared positive-semidefinite kernel and cardinality bound.
sourceNotes: A direction candidate is not an accent, role, or final palette selection.
provenanceNotes: Family support, quality, hue vector, kernel, and selection step remain attached.

artifactTypes.label: Hue-direction diversity marginal-gain trace
artifactTypes.description: The ordered greedy marginal gains, ties, rejected directions, requested cardinality, kernel rank, and rank-defect state.
sourceNotes: The trace must expose zero determinants caused by a requested set larger than the kernel rank.
provenanceNotes: General DPP literature does not erase the repository proposal's exact rank defect.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy root color clusters
artifactTypes.description: Root color clusters with population, connected-component, edge, and centroid observations used by the live legacy election.
sourceNotes: The largest connected root cluster is elected as legacy background.
provenanceNotes: Cluster population and source membership remain attached to elected and rival methods.

artifactTypes.label: Native opaque sRGB8 raster
artifactTypes.description: The once-decoded, native-dimension, three-channel opaque 8-bit sRGB raster with no resampling.
sourceNotes: This is the fixed left product anchor and the NativeRaster output in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:82-96.
provenanceNotes: Native dimensions, pixel order, source hash, and decode identity remain available through paired custody metadata.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy local saliency field
artifactTypes.description: The live root implementation's local saliency values and per-cluster saliency aggregates.
sourceNotes: The legacy role election uses local saliency rather than the v4 research-context salience contracts.
provenanceNotes: Saliency implementation and raster alignment remain explicit.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy independent-role heuristic policy
artifactTypes.description: The live contrast floor, foreground methods, population, saliency, chroma, fallback, alternate-field, accent, gradient-test, and tie policies.
sourceNotes: The caller computes rival methods but returns the original foreground policy with fallbacks.
provenanceNotes: Generated black or white fallback and every independent heuristic remain identifiable.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy independently elected role candidate
artifactTypes.description: Background, surface, foreground, accent, and gradient boolean returned by the live role-by-role heuristic election.
sourceNotes: Independently elected roles need not form a faithful complete treatment.
provenanceNotes: This legacy result is not the exact UI treatment contract and must not be presented as a final contract palette.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy rival role-method diagnostics
artifactTypes.description: Logged foreground and full-palette rival method colors, scores, method names, contrasts, lightness, chroma, and fallback observations.
sourceNotes: The caller logs multiple rivals while its returned policy remains separate.
provenanceNotes: Logging a rival method does not make it jointly reviewed, selected, or a final palette.

notes: The native-seed collection remains one explicit fan-in arm.

inputPorts.label: Native-transition hypotheses
notes: The transition collection may be empty and remains one explicit fan-in arm.

notes: The band-local collection may be empty and remains one explicit fan-in arm.

outputPorts.label: Provenance-preserving hypothesis union
valueStateNotes: Every input record survives as a union member with source type native-seed, native-field-transition, or band-local-endpoint.
notes: Fan-in performs union only: no arbitration, cap, normalization, deduplication, or downstream authority is implied.

notes: Every blend, cliff, ambiguity threshold, evidence band, and tie remains explicit.

inputPorts.label: Source-connected component evidence
notes: Obligation nomination requires source-connected retained role observations.

inputPorts.label: Obligation cap, deduplication, quota, polarity, and reservation policy
notes: The four-seat base, two-neutral quota, opposite-polarity exception and reorder, material-distance deduplication, and two post-cap reservations are explicit.

valueStateNotes: Empty and populated obligation results both carry one trace of evaluated, omitted, exempted, reordered, and major-reserved families.
notes: The chromatic append is reflected in obligations but the historical returned trace has no dedicated chromatic-reservation field.

notes: Polarity is evaluated against the considered field.

notes: Candidates remain subject to legibility rather than winning on text evidence alone.

notes: The cited 2D Gram kernel has rank at most two; larger requests require a separately declared valid higher-rank PSD kernel.

inputPorts.label: Source-supported chromatic families
notes: Source support is gated before determinant diversity so vivid noise is not automatically favored.

inputPorts.label: Smoothing, kernel, and cardinality policy
notes: The requested cardinality must not exceed kernel rank; the cited 2D Gram kernel supports at most two directions.

outputPorts.label: Smoothed direction support field
valueStateNotes: An empty supported-family result is represented by a valid all-zero or explicitly empty support field.
notes: Chroma weighting, circular bins, neighborhood smoothing, near-neutral handling, and support gates remain declared.

outputPorts.label: Finite diverse direction set
valueStateNotes: No direction is emitted when none passes support; output cardinality never exceeds the valid requested and kernel-supported bound.
notes: Directions are nomination hypotheses and not elected roles or palette colors.

outputPorts.label: Marginal-gain and rank trace
valueStateNotes: The trace exists even for an empty or rank-defective result.
notes: For the exact proposed 2D kernel, determinants for sets larger than two are exposed as zero rather than described as repaired by generic DPP literature.
